about.title: Al-Taliyat Foundation for Quranic Recitation
about.body: A Quranic foundation offering rigorous instruction for women, girls, and children through flexible, structured programs — empowering students to master the Holy Quran and earn certification through a connected chain of transmission, in an engaging learning environment built on institutional excellence.
about.slogan: Where the chain connects and mastery is achieved

page.intro: A Quranic foundation specialized in teaching and memorizing the Holy Quran for women, girls, and children — preparing a skilled generation connected to the Prophetic chain of transmission.
page.vision: To be a leading reference in Quran memorization for women and girls, and an innovative environment for preparing teachers connected to the noble Prophetic chain of transmission, through rigorous and diverse programs.
page.mission: A Quranic foundation offering rigorous instruction for women, girls, and children through flexible, structured programs. It empowers students to master the Holy Quran and earn certification through a connected chain, and qualifies certified teachers, in an engaging learning environment built on distinguished institutional performance that fosters gradual growth and future expansion.

values.v1Body: We commit to high-quality Quranic education that achieves the highest standards of precision and tajwid.
values.v2Body: We offer diverse learning models that account for the needs and circumstances of different groups.
values.v3Body: We build the capabilities of students and teachers, empowering them academically and practically.
values.v4Body: We seek to expand our educational impact and reach beneficiaries across the world.
values.v5Body: We adopt professional practices in management and operations to achieve sustainable quality and real impact.

tracks.t1Body: Disciplined memorization programs leading to mastery and certification by chain.
tracks.t2Body: Training memorizers and certified reciters to master teaching and education.
tracks.t3Body: Strong early memorization paired with instilling the etiquette of the Quran.
tracks.t4Body: Remote learning reaching across the world, with quality follow-up and effective communication.

page.objectivesNote: The foundation's purposes are not for material profit:

objectives.o1: Specialized teaching of recitation and memorization of the Holy Quran for social groups.
objectives.o2: Care for teaching the tajwid of the Holy Quran.
objectives.o4: Correction of the recitation of the Holy Quran.
